_meta.scope: Shared Admin and Console API exemptions; Client API has no exemptions.

POST /v3/console/cs/config/clone.reason: cfgId is semantically required by the clone service to select each source configuration, while its generated array-item schema omits required.
POST /v3/console/cs/config/clone.evidence: console/src/main/java/com/alibaba/nacos/console/handler/impl/inner/config/ConfigInnerHandler.java#cloneConfig maps SameNamespaceCloneConfigBean.cfgId to ConfigCloneItem.configId; config/src/main/java/com/alibaba/nacos/config/server/service/ConfigCloneService.java#cloneConfig uses these IDs to select source configurations.
POST /v3/console/cs/config/clone.expires_when: Remove when Swagger marks body[].cfgId required or the clone service supports items without cfgId.
ignore_issues: [必填不一致] request.body[].cfgId: api required=False, doc=True

POST /v3/console/copilot/config.reason: Swagger reuses the full CopilotProperties schema, but the controller intentionally accepts only apiKey, model, studioUrl and studioProject.
POST /v3/console/copilot/config.evidence: console/src/main/java/com/alibaba/nacos/console/controller/v3/ai/ConsoleCopilotConfigController.java#saveConfig binds a JSON @RequestBody but copies only non-null apiKey, model, studioUrl and studioProject; existing enabled and defaultNamespace values are preserved.
POST /v3/console/copilot/config.expires_when: Remove when Swagger exposes a write-specific request model or the controller starts accepting these fields.
ignore_issues: [doc 缺少] request 参数: defaultNamespace
[doc 缺少] request 参数: enabled
